versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Multi-machine WorkBuddy config sync for 3 or more Macs.
- Adds machine naming, registry file (machines.json), and per-machine commit tagging.
- Includes robust conflict resolution and stale lock detection for higher-concurrency setups.
- Provides wbstatus command to view all registered machines, their sync status, and activity.
- Supports both GitHub and iCloud as sync backends.
